defects_found.title: Neither tile doors nor clickable rows navigate anywhere — the shell has no navigation for `tiles[].target` or `rows[].drill_key`.
defects_found.evidence: `ReportsPage.jsx` wires `onDrill={(nextDrill) => writeParams({ drill: JSON.stringify(nextDrill) })}`; `ReportSurface.jsx` calls `onDrill(target)` for tiles and passes `onDrill` to `ReportTable` only when `surface.drill === true`. Measured live in Chromium: clicking `דיילות אדומות` on מ14 left the page on מ14 and put the whole target object into `?drill=…`; `report-row-drillable` count on מ14 = 0 while all 6 rows carry `drill_key {kind:'hostess', id}`.
defects_found.impact: Ruling 33 ('every overview tile is a door') and ruling 19 ('the whole row is the link, to the hostess card מ4') are both invisible on this tab — and on the other three, since the mechanism is shared.
defects_found.fix: `ReportsPage` should branch: a `target` with `{tab, report}` ⇒ `writeParams({tab, report, drill})`; a `drill_key` with `{kind:'hostess', id}` ⇒ `navigate('/hostesses/' + id)` (cross-module door, not a report drill). And `ReportSurface` should pass `onDrill` to `ReportTable` whenever rows carry `drill_key`, not only on drill surfaces.
defects_found.owner: shell (ReportsPage.jsx + ReportSurface.jsx) — outside this step's write area, NOT patched

defects_found.proper_fix: One of: C8 adds `compare.format` and the RPCs emit it, OR `CompareLine` falls back to `tile.format`. The second is two characters and fixes all four tabs at once — recommended.

🔴 **`transformPayload` runs on every render and is not memoised.** `ReportSurface` calls `transformPayload(rawPayload)` in the render body, so every chip toggle re-maps the chart data and re-filters the rows; on מ15 that is 6 chart rows + 87 table rows, trivial today. **The trap is the next person:** anyone who adds a text input to `renderTop` gets a full payload re-map per keystroke, silently. **Checkable:** put a `console.count()` inside `mapChartLabels`, toggle a chip five times, and read the counter — it should be 5, and it is; then add a controlled input and watch it become per-keystroke.

🔴 **My weekday selector and the shell's `drill` param share one namespace.** I write `{dow: N}` into the same URL key the drill surfaces use for `{kind, id}`. `ReportsPage.setReport` clears it on every report switch, so today they cannot collide — **but that is the only thing preventing it**, and it is a line in a file I do not own. **Checkable:** open `/reports?tab=hostesses&report=reliability&drill=%7B%22kind%22%3A%22customer%22%2C%22id%22%3A401%7D` by hand — `Number.isInteger(drill.dow)` is false so no day is selected, the RPC ignores the unknown object and echoes it, and the page renders normally.
